data.exact_reserve_text: The reserves established in 2020 have proved to be adequate and we have been able to make releases during 2021, especially on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, which are now reinsured under a Loss Portfolio Transfer arrangement.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfer to Medical Professional Mutual Insurance Company
prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsured the loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account providing stability to the Syndicate on any future loss movements; a reinsurance recovery of GBP 28.0m is included in the net technical provisions.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded gross prior-year reserve releases of approximately GBP 9.54m (about 11.7% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by favourable development on the 2018 and 2019 years of account. Those years were also reinsured in December 2021 via a Loss Portfolio Transfer to Medical Professional Mutual Insurance Company (a GBP 28.0m reinsurance recovery), which materially improved net reserves and provided stability.
raw_causal_phrases: The reserves established in 2020 have proved to be adequate and we have been able to make releases during 2021, especially on the 2018 and 2019 years of account, which are now reinsured under a Loss Portfolio Transfer arrangement.
An LPT has been put into place in December 2021 reinsuring the loss reserves on the 2018 and 2019 years of account to Medical Professional Mutual Insurance Company.
The reinsurance recovery included within the Net Technical Provisions as part of the LPT was GBP 28.0m.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims incurred by underwriting year) printed in the technical reserves note. The triangle only contains underwriting years 2018-2021; PYD was computed by excluding 2021 and 2020 and summing changes for 2018 and 2019. The syndicate completed a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) in Dec 2021 with a GBP 28.0m reinsurance recovery which materially affects net reserves but does not directly change gross claims estimates - net movements in the accounts are therefore larger than the gross PYD computed here. Gross premium mix is taken from the underwriting analysis note (not a formal regulatory segmental table); amounts and percentages round to the total gross written premium. Confidence: PYD = 0.8 (calculated from triangle).
